facts.fact: The MFWA study states that the government approved the telecommunications and ICT sector policy document for 2013-2020 by decree No. 2013-158 of 12 April 2013.
facts.system: Document de politique sectorielle des télécommunications et des TIC (2013-2020)

facts.fact: The MFWA study gives the sector policy document's period as 2013-2020 and says the country was at the end of that period in 2020.
facts.system: Document de politique sectorielle des télécommunications et des TIC (2013-2020)

facts.fact: The MFWA study says the 2013-2020 sector policy document is built on five strategic axes: legal and institutional framework, infrastructure, universal access to ICT services, applications and content, and ICT capacity building.
facts.system: Document de politique sectorielle des télécommunications et des TIC (2013-2020)

facts.fact: The MFWA study states that on 20 July 2020 the government launched the process of drawing up a digital policy for 2021-2030, named Niger Numérique 2021-2030, through a study to give the government a policy document.
The MFWA study gives the planned period of the Niger Numérique digital policy under preparation as 2021-2030.
